description: Schallpegel Flughafen Leipzig/Halle DEN (24 h-Pegel) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Implementation of Directive 2002/49/EC on the assessment and management of environmental noise in Saxony. Presentation of the aircraft noise pollution around Leipzig/Halle airport for the 24-hour assessment level LDEN (day/evening/night). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Sound level Leipzig/Halle Airport DEN (24 h level)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gesundheit und Sicherheit, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
